tasks.label: package-and-unpack-vsix
tasks.command: cd thinking-logger-ui && npm install --legacy-peer-deps && npm run build && npx --yes vsce package && cd .. && rm -rf .tmp-vsix/extension && mkdir -p .tmp-vsix/extension && unzip -q -o $(ls -t thinking-logger-ui/thinking-logger-view-*.vsix | head -1) -d .tmp-vsix/extension
